project_goal: Open the next non-analyst fundamentals branch after the failed sentiment and option fallback lanes, starting from sales_delta_fundamental and iterating until one line reaches candidate quality or the lane is structurally blocked.

features.title: Create the fourth-cycle fundamentals research queue
features.description: Build the next queue around sales_delta_fundamental with one slower fundamentals fallback and one lower-priority structural backup.
acceptance_criteria: A real queue JSON exists under runs/research-queues.
The queue is compatible with the local research_queue_builder script.
The queue contains the sales-delta primary lane and at least one distinct fundamentals fallback.

features.title: Create the sales-delta field-search pack
features.description: Create a field-search pack for the sales_delta_fundamental lane with fresh official field verification and likely failure modes.
acceptance_criteria: A markdown field-search pack exists under runs/field-search-packs.
The pack records fresh official field verification for the chosen fundamentals field.
The pack clearly separates confirmed facts from planning assumptions.

features.title: Draft the sales-delta expression family
features.description: Create a simple baseline plus small, justified variants for the new fundamentals lane.
acceptance_criteria: A markdown expression family file exists under runs/expression-families.
The file includes one baseline and at least three variants.
Each variant has a stated purpose or bottleneck target.

features.title: Capture the sales-delta simulation results
features.description: Record real platform metrics and evidence for the first sales-delta batch once the new expressions are simulated.
acceptance_criteria: A simulation capture JSON exists under runs/simulation-captures.
The capture includes real platform metrics only.
Evidence artifacts exist for the capture.

features.title: Build the sales-delta candidate batch
features.description: Convert the real sales-delta simulation outputs into a submit / polish / branch / kill candidate batch when real check evidence supports it.
acceptance_criteria: A candidate batch JSON exists under runs/candidate-batches.
The candidate batch is compatible with the local candidate_scorecard script.
The batch contains real metrics only.

features.title: Write the fourth-cycle daily note
features.description: Record the fundamentals follow-up session in the daily note format after the planning artifacts and first simulations exist.
acceptance_criteria: A daily note JSON exists under runs/notes/daily.
The JSON is compatible with the local session_note_scaffold daily mode.
The note references real work from the current cycle.

features.title: Prepare the fundamentals submission memo
features.description: Write a submission memo grounded in real sales-delta results and official checks if the lane reaches candidate quality.
acceptance_criteria: A submission memo markdown file exists under runs/submission-memos.
The memo references real simulation and test results.
The memo does not claim readiness without official platform evidence.
